# E-Mail sending service

> A generic e-mail sending service that exposes a contract for others to send e-mails with a given content

- **System:** [e-mail-sending-service](../index.md#e-mail-sending-service)
- **Caller:** Internal — the caller is inside the trust boundary
- **Blast radius:** High
- **Source:** [`email_service.yamlet.yaml`](../../../../../specs_example/email_service.yamlet.yaml)

The generic e-mail sending service delivers any e-mail the platform needs to send, so no other component has to know how e-mail is sent. An e-mail it accepts is delivered or reported as undeliverable, never silently lost.

## Contract

`e-mail-sending-service` — send an e-mail with a subject, content and attachment to a recipient

- **Inputs:** `recipient`, `subject`, `content`, `attachment`
- **Outputs:** none

## Requirements

<a id="rq-1"></a>

### RQ-1 · A requested e-mail reaches its recipient with the given subject, content and attachment

<a id="ac-1"></a>
**AC-1** · When a send is requested for `recipient`, the system shall:

- deliver an e-mail to `recipient`
- use `subject` as the e-mail subject
- use `content` as the e-mail body
- attach `attachment` to the e-mail

<a id="rq-2"></a>

### RQ-2 · A requested e-mail is never silently lost

<a id="ac-2"></a>
**AC-2** · If the e-mail to `recipient` cannot be delivered right away, then the system shall:

- deliver the e-mail to `recipient` within 24 hours of the request

<a id="ac-3"></a>
**AC-3** · If the e-mail to `recipient` is still undelivered 24 hours after the request, then the system shall:

- mark the e-mail to `recipient` as undeliverable

## Used by

- [PDF e-mail archiver](../pdf-archiver/pdf_archiver.md) as `mailer`
- [Resilient PDF e-mail archiver](../pdf-archiver/pdf_archiver_resilient.md) as `mailer`
